§7.3.10 Signatures

📄 Page rule — applied from the page alone

text-signatures · text marks

✅ Normative

A handwritten signature MUST be rendered as a bracketed placeholder: [signature:{name}] when its glyphs are genuinely legible, the bare [signature] otherwise. A name MUST NOT be guessed.

A handwritten signature over a signature line.

The rendering

A signature whose name can be read from its glyphs:

[signature:Mariana Augusta de Figueiredo Lacerda e Souza]

A signature whose name cannot:

[signature]

A half-readable signature MUST get the bare [signature] form.

Why

A signature is semantically meaningful — the document is signed — but it is not text. The placeholder records the fact without asserting a transcription that could be wrong, and the name-carrying form preserves the value when the glyphs really are readable.

This is the same shape as [REDACTED] in Redacted Text§7.3.8: a bracketed tag standing in for a non-text region.

Edge cases

  • Two signatures on one line MUST get two placeholders, one each, in reading order — even when both are illegible.
  • A signature that is also a stamp, or that overlaps a printed grid, follows Handwriting and Stamps§9.6.5.

On a form

A signature field follows the same shapes, with one addition: an unsigned field is a blank fill-in, [blank], not a missing signature.

- **Your signature**: [signature:John Doe]
- **Spouse's signature. If a joint return, both must sign.**: [blank]
- **Date**: [blank]
- **Your occupation**: Accountant

A signature line's date and occupation companions are ordinary fill-ins — see Fill-Ins§10.4.4.

A signature with its name printed beside it

The name in [signature:{name}] is read off the signature's own glyphs. Many documents print the signer's name directly under the signature line.

A name printed under or beside an illegible signature MUST NOT fill [signature:{name}]: the signature is the bare [signature], and the printed name is rendered as the text it is. The tag records only what the strokes show — the printed name is not always the signer, as when someone signs on another's behalf — and the name is kept as text beside it, so nothing is lost.

✅ Sample — an auditor's signature over a printed name

A handwritten signature whose glyphs cannot be read, with A. N. Bhatt, Partner, a membership number and a UDIN printed beneath it, and the firm's round seal to the left — see Seals and Round Stamps§7.3.9.

Expected Markdown · excerpt, the signature block

…

For, Caldrivane & Rao LLP Chartered Accountants Firm Registration No. - 118427W/W100284

[signature]

A. N. Bhatt Partner Membership No. 084213 UDIN: 26084213MZQPKT2231

…

Initials on every page

Handwritten approval initials MUST be rendered as [signature] on every page that carries them, with the initials inside the placeholder only when their glyphs support it. The placeholder MUST be kept outside body sentences.

✅ Sample — a scanned decision with a paraph

A handwritten mark at the bottom right of a scanned court decision page, below the footnotes, with no printed line or caption. No letters can be read in it.

Expected Markdown · excerpt, foot of the page

…

37 Id. at 78–89. The August 11, 2023 Order in DRB Case No. 04-88 was approved by Chairperson Teodora L. Escamillas and Member Victor P. Renwick of the Construction Industry Arbitration Commission, Caldrivane City.

[signature]

Markdown source
<!-- … -->


<sup>37</sup> Id. at 78–89. The August 11, 2023 Order in DRB Case No. 04-88 was approved by Chairperson Teodora L. Escamillas and Member Victor P. Renwick of the Construction Industry Arbitration Commission, Caldrivane City.


[signature]

Typed names on signature lines

A name typed in a plain face on a signature line, or a conformed /s/ signature, is not a signature: it is printed text. It MUST be rendered as that text, verbatim — /s/ included — and MUST NOT be given a [signature] placeholder, which would assert handwriting the page does not show.

✅ Sample — typed names on signature lines

Marcus Feldkirk, Renata Solis, Owen Tarrant typed in a plain face on the three signature lines of an approval box, with typed dates. No handwriting anywhere.

Expected Markdown · excerpt, the approval box

…

Read and approved by

Marcus Feldkirk 12/03/2025 Renata Solis 12/04/2025 Owen Tarrant 12/04/2025

Markdown source

✅ Sample — a conformed /s/ signature

By: /s/ Dana R. Whitfield in underlined italics on the signature line, the typed name beneath. The /s/ convention stands for a signature that was never inked.
